stage: Three hero concepts; implementation awaits user selection

concepts.name: Монтажный стол
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE exceptionally original and buildable DESKTOP WEBSITE HERO SECTION for SCENE, a conceptual AI studio for short vertical videos. This is visual direction 01, called EDITING TABLE. Flat frontal screenshot landscape16:10 around1440x900, no browser chrome, no device frame, no multi-option collage. All real interface text Russian except SCENE brand. Art direction: sophisticated independent film-editing studio meets expressive editorial product design, warm ivory background #F4F0E9, bold cobalt #2D4BFF, tiny coral #FF826C accents, dark navy ink #20233A. Entire first screen must fit a small laptop: generously spaced but compact enough for visible CTA and bottom timeline. A precise open asymmetrical composition, NOT boxed SaaS panels. Header black custom geometric SCENE wordmark upper left with minimal two-rectangle mark, center plain links «Процесс», «Примеры», «Попробовать», upper right small cobalt square containing northeast arrow. Left half enormous confident rounded-geometric grotesk Cyrillic heading in 3 lines, exactly «Из мысли —
в первый
кадр.» Strong typographic personality, approximately110px bold, navy with last word cobalt. Above it one small legible unboxed label «AI-СТУДИЯ КОРОТКИХ ВИДЕО». Below it two lines of supporting text «Собери историю, которую
захочется досмотреть.» And clear cobalt rectangular CTA «Попробовать SCENE ↗», plus a quiet adjacent note «15 секунд. Твоя история.» On right, one visually stunning tall 9:16 FILM FRAME, NOT a giant app dashboard and NOT a realistic phone: a cinematic photograph of sunlit coral-orange Mediterranean stairs leading toward electric-blue sea, beautiful light and shadow. Small white typography over photograph «Выйди
за кадр.» Two smaller offset raw photographic frames just behind the main frame imply the footage becoming an edited sequence, subtle paper shadow, crisp white edges, no rounded pill containers. At bottom of hero, a fine open editing TIMELINE runs horizontally over about80percent width, with ruler tick marks and three separate clip strips showing tiny stills from the same sunny landscape, small coral playhead and useful labels «Идея», «Сцены», «Ролик». One small plain caption near timeline reads «01: сценарий → 02: кадры → 03: твой ролик». Small graphic cut marks or viewfinder corners only where useful. Clear readable Cyrillic text, rich visual media, precise typography, plenty of purposeful negative space. No AI sparkles, no violet gradients, no dark lime palette, no fake metrics, no partner logos, no testimonials, no pricing tables, no nested card UI, no generic stock team portraits. The screenshot is a clear reference for live HTML and layered imagery, not a flattened artwork pretending to be a website.

concepts.name: Живой коллаж
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE exceptionally art-directed, buildable desktop website FIRST SCREEN for SCENE, a conceptual AI studio for short videos. Direction02: LIVING COLLAGE. This must be a genuinely different composition from a conventional left-copy/right-product hero. Flat frontal screenshot landscape16:10 approximately1440x900, no browser chrome, no device frame, no collage of website alternatives. Website itself is a curated airy editorial collage. Warm milk background #F4F0E9, navy-black text #20233A, cobalt #2D4BFF, small coral #FF826C accents. Independent contemporary film magazine / creative production studio mood. Top SCENE wordmark upper left, plain nav «Процесс», «Примеры», «Попробовать» upper right. At visual center an enormous bold expressive geometric grotesk Cyrillic headline EXACT «Хорошие идеи
должны
двигаться.» across3 lines; final word cobalt blue and slightly italic, confidently typeset, entire headline fully readable and isolated in negative space. Carefully positioned around this central typographic island are ONLY THREE meaningful creative artifacts, balanced like physical objects on a light table: upper-left a slightly rotated sharp-edged vertical photographic print of a MALE runner in cobalt blue training clothes at a sunlit sports track, full body in motion, crisp editorial photography with a small film timecode at bottom; upper-right a vertical photographic print of soft coral desert dunes under brilliant blue sky with a tiny lone traveler, rotated opposite direction; lower-right a small ivory torn-paper NOTE with real large text «Показать приложение
за 15 секунд.» and a simple dark hand-drawn rectangular screen wireframe, cobalt editorial crop marks. These artifacts each occupy at most15percent area and must never cover the central headline or CTA. Two tiny coral editorial arrows or a thin drawn path suggest raw ideas gathering into a story, no decorative dashboard jargon. Beneath headline, centered concise legible text «Твои мысли, кадры и ритм.
Одна история, которую хочется смотреть.» Clear cobalt rectangular CTA «Собрать первую историю ↗» centered below, followed by a quiet plain-text note «Начни с готового сценария». Along bottom edge a restrained minimal three-frame cinematic strip or horizontal hairline ruler, with plain small labels «Приложение», «Путешествие», «Спорт» suggesting useful example selector, not tabs in rounded pill containers. Strong depth from subtle photographic paper edges and natural soft shadows, editorial precision, beautiful asymmetry, wide comfortable margins. Large readable Russian copy, short powerful header, visible CTA above bottom edge on a small laptop. Avoid SaaS split hero, dark background, lime accents, generic gradients, bento grids, overlapping nested cards, badges, fake users and invented numbers, stock portraits, cartoon AI icons. This should feel playful, thoughtful and premium, with each media artifact serving the short-video story, not random clutter. Only this hero.

concepts.name: Сцена одним кадром
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE striking premium desktop website FIRST SCREEN for SCENE, a conceptual AI studio for short vertical videos. Visual direction03: ONE FRAME, ONE SCENE. Landscape16:10 approx1440x900, flat straight-on website screenshot, NO browser chrome, NO devices, NO multi-alternative board. It must be compositionally different from a pale left-text/right-photo-stack SaaS hero and from scattered paper collage. Full-bleed rich saturated COBALT BLUE #2D4BFF backdrop, warm white #F4F0E9 bold typography, restrained coral #FF826C accents. Confident art direction of an experimental contemporary motion-design studio. Header warm-white SCENE wordmark at upper left, simple legible text nav «Процесс», «Примеры», «Попробовать» at upper right, no boxed navbar. Composition is centered and cinematic, like a carefully composed title sequence. Enormous sophisticated geometric grotesk Cyrillic headline spans upper center in two lines, EXACT «Дай идее
движение.» white bold, approximately110px, almost screen-wide but with generous breathing room. Immediately below the headline a single very large HORIZONTAL cinematic open frame, centered width75percent and about330px tall, with beautiful warm off-white viewfinder corner brackets, NOT a rounded card. Inside frame: one vivid art-directed photographic scene of a solitary traveler in a coral jacket on the edge of pale sculptural cliffs overlooking a very blue Mediterranean sea, crisp sun and shadow, editorial real photography, coherent blue-coral-white world. Within this one landscape scene, thin white 9:16 crop guide lines select the traveler at center, implying turning an idea into a vertical story. One tiny useful coral timeline mark and timecode «00:05 / 00:15» at the bottom right edge of the frame, no random UI labels. Over the photograph a very short large white film title near lower left «За пределами
привычного.» Outside photograph below frame centered small white body copy «От первой мысли до истории,
которую хочется досмотреть.» One clearly visible CORAL rectangular primary CTA centered near lower edge with dark navy text «Создать свою SCENE ↗». Small plain secondary label under it «Попробуй готовый сценарий». At left and right of the wide frame leave broad blue negative space with only two super-fine white horizontal guide lines, intentionally precise. No side-by-side copy/photo split, no floating photo stack, no paper notes, no grid of cards, no gradient blobs, no black/lime palette, no fake logos, no social-proof counts, no pricing. All main text large and readable. Use flat vibrant color, huge confident type, one photographic scene and exceptional composition. Everything including primary CTA must fit a first viewport; the screenshot is a buildable interface reference whose typography and guide lines can be live HTML/CSS/SVG.
